turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, Orion Shield Insurance, Hannah speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my car policy. I found something cheaper and, frankly, I'm annoyed about the price rise. I'm worried I'll lose a lot of money.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, Tomas, that must be really stressful. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. I'll skip the usual security questions as you've had a stressful time, let's just get on with it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Oh, okay. Thank you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I'm sorry if I'm a bit slow today, my partner passed away last month and they always dealt with all of this.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry for your loss. Please take all the time you need, I'll go slowly, and I can send everything in writing or arrange a callback from our priority support team.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you'd like to cancel your car policy. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm which policy this is, car or home?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The car insurance.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, the change is subject to an underwriting review and a pro-rata premium adjustment, with any mid-term amendment fee applied.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you promise me this won't cost me anything extra?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise how it will be priced, the system will calculate it and you'll get it in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just waive the fee? It seems unfair.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. As it's past the 14-day cooling-off period, the refund is pro-rata, which just means you get back the unused part of your premium, less a $25 administration fee.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Tomas. I've logged your cancellation request under reference REQ-36907, and our policy services team will process it and confirm in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've logged your cancellation request.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
